title: Distinguishing graphs with simple spectrum by homomorphism counts
summary: We study which graph classes determine every graph with simple spectrum up to isomorphism by homomorphism counts from their members. We show that such a class has unbounded treewidth and Euler genus and contains a graph with the complete graph on seven vertices as a minor. To prove these conditions, we construct pairs of non-isomorphic cospectral graphs with simple spectrum, each bipartite, nonsingular and of maximum degree at most six. The construction attaches rooted trees to Cai-Furer-Immerman graphs and preserves homomorphism indistinguishability over every minor-closed class. We then prove that subcubic homomorphism counts determine every graph whose adjacency matrix has kernel dimension at most one. This extends the known result for nonsingular graphs and applies to all graphs with simple spectrum. We also prove that two graphs have the same subcubic homomorphism counts if and only if they have the same number of vertices and there is a bijective linear isometry between the images of their adjacency matrices that intertwines the adjacency operators and preserves the coordinatewise trilinear forms. Finally, we prove that homomorphism counts from the single-vertex graph and from subdivisions of any sequence of connected cubic graphs have the same distinguishing power as subcubic homomorphism counts if every complete graph is a minor of some member of the sequence.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了哪些图类通过同态计数能够区分所有具有简单谱的图，并证明了此类图类必须具有无界树宽和欧拉亏格，且包含 $K_7$ 作为子式；同时给出了子三次同态计数区分核维数至多为一的图的刻画。
AI.motivation: 同态计数是图同构测试和谱图理论中的重要工具，但此前对于具有简单谱的图，哪些图类能通过同态计数完全区分它们尚不清楚。该问题与图同构、谱决定性和同态不可区分性等经典问题密切相关，填补了简单谱图在同态计数区分能力上的空白。
AI.method: 构造了基于 Cai-Furer-Immerman 图并附加有根树的一对非合同谱简单谱图，它们保持对任意 minor-closed 类的同态不可区分性；利用子三次同态计数、邻接矩阵的核空间以及坐标三线性形式等代数工具进行刻画。
AI.result: 任何能通过同态计数区分所有简单谱图的图类必须具有无界树宽和欧拉亏格，并包含 $K_7$ 作为子式。子三次同态计数能区分所有邻接矩阵核维数至多为一的图，这推广了非奇异图的结果。两个图具有相同子三次同态计数当且仅当它们顶点数相同，且其邻接矩阵的像之间存在一个双射线性等距，该等距与邻接算子交换并保持坐标三线性形式。此外，若每个完全图都是某个连通三次图序列中某个成员的子式，则单顶点图和该序列的细分图的同态计数与子三次同态计数具有相同的区分能力。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果揭示了同态计数区分简单谱图的局限性，并给出了子三次同态计数区分能力的精确代数刻画。未解决的问题包括：对于核维数大于一的图，子三次同态计数是否仍能区分？以及是否存在更小的图类（如树宽有界）能区分所有简单谱图？
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括：研究其他图类（如平面图或有界亏格图）的同态计数区分能力；将子三次同态计数的刻画推广到核维数更高的图；以及探索同态计数与图同构测试复杂度之间的关系。

title: Inheritance of expansion and oriented Hamilton cycles in robust expanders: a regularity-free proof
summary: Häggkvist and Thomason proved that every $n$-vertex oriented graph with minimum semidegree at least $(\frac{5}{12}+o(1))n$ contains every orientation of a Hamilton cycle. Using Szemerédi's regularity lemma, Kelly later improved this to the asymptotically sharp bound $(\frac{3}{8}+o(1))n$. Taylor subsequently generalized Kelly's theorem by proving that every sufficiently large robust outexpander with linear minimum semidegree contains every orientation of a Hamilton cycle. We revisit Häggkvist and Thomason's proof and show that it can be modified to give a regularity-free proof of Taylor's theorem (and thus Kelly's theorem). Building on this, we also give regularity-free proofs of related results on Hamilton-connectivity and linkage in robust outexpanders. As applications of these results, we are able to replace the use of the regularity lemma in known results on arbitrary orientations of Hamilton cycles in $n$-vertex digraphs with minimum semidegree at least $\frac{n}{2}$ and in $n$-vertex digraphs with minimum total degree at least $(1+o(1))n$. The first step is to show that, in an $n$-vertex robust outexpander with linear minimum semidegree, two uniformly chosen disjoint sets of logarithmic size satisfy Hall's condition with high probability. The second is to show that robust expansion is inherited by uniformly chosen linear sized sets. In both cases, we use the graph-container methods of Kleitman--Winston and Sapozhenko to reduce the possible obstructions to a small enough family to permit a union bound.

AI.tldr: 本文给出了 Taylor 关于 robust outexpander 中 Hamilton 圈定向的定理的一个无 regularity 证明，并推广到 Hamilton-连通性和 linkage 等相关结果。
AI.motivation: Häggkvist 和 Thomason 最早研究了有向图中 Hamilton 圈定向的最小半度条件，Kelly 用 regularity lemma 改进到渐近最优的 $(\frac{3}{8}+o(1))n$，Taylor 进一步推广到 robust outexpander。本文旨在去除这些证明中对 Szemerédi's regularity lemma 的依赖，提供更直接、更一般的证明框架。
AI.method: 作者重新审视 Häggkvist 和 Thomason 的原始证明，通过修改使其适用于 robust outexpander。关键技术包括：证明在具有线性最小半度的 robust outexpander 中，两个均匀选取的对数大小不相交集合以高概率满足 Hall 条件；证明 robust expansion 被均匀选取的线性大小集合继承；并使用 Kleitman--Winston 和 Sapozhenko 的 graph-container 方法将可能的障碍归约到足够小的族以应用 union bound。
AI.result: 本文给出了 Taylor 定理的无 regularity 证明：每个充分大的具有线性最小半度的 robust outexpander 包含 Hamilton 圈的每个定向。由此也重新证明了 Kelly 的定理：每个 $n$ 顶点有向图若最小半度至少为 $(\frac{3}{8}+o(1))n$，则包含 Hamilton 圈的每个定向。此外，还给出了 robust outexpander 中 Hamilton-连通性和 linkage 相关结果的无 regularity 证明，并应用于最小半度至少 $\frac{n}{2}$ 的 $n$ 顶点有向图以及最小总度至少 $(1+o(1))n$ 的 $n$ 顶点有向图中任意 Hamilton 圈定向的已知结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文表明 Szemerédi's regularity lemma 在 robust outexpander 的 Hamilton 圈定向问题中并非必要，所发展的无 regularity 方法可能适用于更广泛的有向图嵌入问题。这为理解 robust expansion 与 Hamilton 圈定向之间的关系提供了新视角，并可能推动其他相关问题的无 regularity 证明。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出 open problems，但自然延伸包括：将无 regularity 方法应用于其他类型的 Hamilton 圈问题（如有向图的 Hamilton 圈、超图中的 Hamilton 圈），以及探索 robust outexpander 中更一般的子图嵌入问题。此外，能否进一步降低最小半度条件或推广到非均匀选取的集合也值得研究。

title: Double-Partition Coloring problem: a unified approach for conflict-free coloring of hypergraphs and other coloring problems in graphs
summary: The Double-Partition Coloring Problem (DPCP) is a recently introduced generalization of several coloring problems on graphs and hypergraphs, including the Partition Coloring Problem, the List Coloring Problem, and the Conflict-Free Coloring Problem (CFCP). In this work, we further investigate the structural and computational properties of the DPCP and develop exact and heuristic solution approaches. We derive structural results that allow the detection of infeasible instances and the reduction of their size. We propose one-step and two-step heuristics for obtaining high-quality solutions. These procedures are incorporated into an enhanced branch-and-price algorithm based on a set covering formulation of the DPCP. The algorithm further includes new strategies for solving the NP-hard pricing problem. Computational experiments show that the proposed branch-and-price algorithm and a compact integer programming formulation complement each other: while the compact formulation is generally more effective on sparse instances, branch-and-price performs particularly well on denser and larger instances. In particular, these are the first exact algorithms to be computationally evaluated on various CFCP instances.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了 Double-Partition Coloring Problem (DPCP)，给出了结构性质、启发式算法和基于 set covering 的 branch-and-price 精确算法，并在 Conflict-Free Coloring Problem (CFCP) 等实例上进行了计算评估。
AI.motivation: DPCP 是 Partition Coloring Problem、List Coloring Problem 和 Conflict-Free Coloring Problem (CFCP) 等若干图与超图着色问题的统一推广，但此前缺乏系统的算法研究，尤其是 CFCP 尚无精确算法被计算评估。
AI.method: 利用结构性质检测不可行实例并约简规模；设计 one-step 和 two-step 启发式；基于 set covering 形式化建立增强的 branch-and-price 算法，并针对 NP-hard pricing problem 提出新策略；与紧凑整数规划 formulation 进行对比。
AI.result: 提出的 branch-and-price 算法与紧凑整数规划 formulation 互补：紧凑 formulation 在稀疏实例上更有效，而 branch-and-price 在更稠密和更大实例上表现更好；这是首次对多种 CFCP 实例进行精确算法的计算评估。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为 DPCP 提供了统一且有效的精确与启发式求解框架，并首次在 CFCP 实例上验证了精确算法的可行性，推动了冲突无关着色问题的算法研究。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出 open problems，未来可进一步优化 pricing problem 的求解策略、扩展算法到更大规模实例，并探索 DPCP 在更多着色问题变体中的应用。

title: Coloring Monomial Cayley Graphs: The One-Parameter Case
summary: How do algebraic relations among unit directions influence the chromatic number of the plane? We introduce monomial Cayley graphs as a framework for investigating this question, beginning with graphs whose allowed unit steps are signed powers of a single complex parameter. Transcendental parameters give bipartite graphs, while for roots of unity we determine both the chromatic and circular chromatic numbers. As a geometric consequence, every graph admitting a unit-distance embedding in the plane in which the angle between any two edge directions is a rational multiple of $π$ is three-colorable. For algebraic noninteger parameters, four colors suffice, and three suffice when the primitive integer minimal polynomial has leading coefficient at least three. We conjecture that three colors suffice for every algebraic noninteger direction parameter and that four suffice for every direction parameter.
comment: 50 pages; ancillary data and verification scripts included

AI.tldr: 本文引入单项式 Cayley 图（monomial Cayley graphs）作为研究代数关系如何影响平面染色数（chromatic number of the plane）的框架，并确定了一类由单个复参数的有符号幂生成的图的染色数与圆染色数。
AI.motivation: 平面染色数问题（Hadwiger-Nelson 问题）询问染色平面所需的最少颜色数，已知在 5 到 7 之间。理解单位方向之间的代数关系如何影响染色数，是缩小这一差距的关键。本文通过单项式 Cayley 图提供了一个可控的代数框架，填补了从代数参数角度系统研究平面染色数问题的空白。
AI.method: 作者定义了单项式 Cayley 图，其顶点为复数域，边由单个复参数的有符号幂生成。利用代数数论（如本原整数最小多项式）和图染色理论（包括圆染色数），结合超越参数与单位根的分类讨论，以及几何嵌入的角度条件分析。
AI.result: 对于超越参数，图是二部图；对于单位根，确定了染色数和圆染色数。几何推论：若平面单位距离嵌入中任意两条边方向的夹角是 $\pi$ 的有理倍数，则该图是 3-可染的。对于代数非整数参数，4 种颜色足够；当本原整数最小多项式的首项系数至少为 3 时，3 种颜色足够。作者猜想：对每个代数非整数方向参数，3 种颜色足够；对每个方向参数，4 种颜色足够。
AI.conclusion: 本文为平面染色数问题提供了一个新的代数视角，通过单项式 Cayley 图将染色数与方向参数的代数性质联系起来。结果支持了平面染色数可能为 4 或 5 的猜想，并提出了两个关于代数参数的染色数猜想。
AI.future_work: 论文提出的主要开放问题包括：证明或否定“每个代数非整数方向参数 3 色足够”以及“每个方向参数 4 色足够”的猜想。此外，将单项式 Cayley 图框架推广到多参数情形或更一般的代数关系，也是自然的延伸方向。

title: Dynamic Coloring and Graph Squares of Regular Graphs
summary: An $r$-dynamic coloring of a graph $G$ is a proper vertex coloring in which every vertex $v$ sees at least $\min\{r,d(v)\}$ distinct colors in its neighborhood. The minimum number of colors in such a coloring is the $r$-dynamic chromatic number $χ_r(G)$. We study dynamic colorings of regular graphs. A straighforward observation shows that $χ_r(G)=χ(G^2)$, for any $r$-regular graph $G$. We prove that $χ_3(G)=χ(G^2)\le6$ for every claw-free cubic graph $G$, and the bound is sharp. For Hamiltonian claw-free cubic graphs, we improve the bound to $5$ apart from four explicit exceptions. We also determine exactly the $r$-dynamic chromatic number of the $4$-regular circulant graph $C_p(1,3)$ for each $r\in\{2,3,4\}$. In particular, the case $r=4$ determines $χ(C^2_p(1,3))$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了正则图的 $r$-dynamic coloring，证明了无爪三次图的 $\chi_3(G) = \chi(G^2) \le 6$ 且界是紧的，并对哈密顿无爪三次图改进了界，同时确定了 $4$-正则循环图 $C_p(1,3)$ 的 $r$-dynamic 色数。
AI.motivation: $r$-dynamic coloring 是经典顶点着色的推广，与图的平方的着色有密切联系。对于正则图，$\chi_r(G) = \chi(G^2)$ 这一观察将动态着色与图平方的色数联系起来，但关于无爪三次图等特定图类的精确界尚不清楚。本文填补了无爪三次图及其哈密顿情形下 $r$-dynamic 色数的空白，并精确计算了一类循环图的动态色数。
AI.method: 主要利用图平方的着色性质，结合无爪三次图的结构分析（如边着色、匹配和哈密顿圈的存在性），以及循环图的代数与组合方法。对于哈密顿无爪三次图，通过分类讨论和排除四个显式例外来改进上界。
AI.result: 对于每个无爪三次图 $G$，有 $\chi_3(G) = \chi(G^2) \le 6$，且该界是紧的。若 $G$ 是哈密顿无爪三次图，则除四个显式例外外，$\chi_3(G) \le 5$。此外，对于 $4$-正则循环图 $C_p(1,3)$，确定了每个 $r \in \{2,3,4\}$ 的 $r$-dynamic 色数；特别地，$r=4$ 时得到 $\chi(C_p^2(1,3))$ 的精确值。
AI.conclusion: 本文的结果推进了正则图动态着色的研究，给出了无爪三次图 $r$-dynamic 色数的紧界，并精确计算了一类循环图的动态色数。这些结果有助于理解图平方的色数与动态着色之间的关系，并为更一般的图类提供了参考。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括：确定其他图类（如无爪 $k$-正则图）的 $r$-dynamic 色数，研究非哈密顿无爪三次图的精确界，以及探索动态着色与图平方色数之间更一般的联系。

title: An asymptotically tight bound on oriented diameter
summary: Let $f(d)$ be the smallest integer such that every finite connected bridgeless simple graph of diameter $d$ admits a strong orientation of diameter at most $f(d)$. Chvátal and Thomassen (1978) proved $\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d\le f(d)\le2d^2+2d$. In this paper, we prove that $\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d\le f(d)\le\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d+18$ for every $d\ge2$, which shows that $f(d)=\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d+O(1)$ and determines both the quadratic and linear terms up to a bounded additive error. The key method of our proof is to construct a central subgraph $H$ that admits a strong orientation of diameter $O(d)$ and is within distance $\lfloor d/2\rfloor$ of every vertex outside it. We obtain the sharp linear coefficient by jointly estimating outside paths and their connecting paths in $H$ at the actual attachment vertices, rebuilding $H$ when necessary.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了每个有限连通无桥简单图若直径为 $d$，则存在强定向使其直径至多 $\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d+18$，从而确定 $f(d)=\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d+O(1)$。
AI.motivation: 确定函数 $f(d)$ 是强定向直径问题的核心，Chvátal 和 Thomassen 在 1978 年给出了上下界 $\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d\le f(d)\le 2d^2+2d$，但二次项和线性项的精确系数长期未定。本文填补了这一空白，将上界改进到与下界仅差常数 18，从而确定 $f(d)$ 的渐近精确值。
AI.method: 证明的关键是构造一个中心子图 $H$，它允许一个直径为 $O(d)$ 的强定向，并且距离每个外部顶点至多 $\lfloor d/2\rfloor$。通过在实际附着顶点处联合估计外部路径及其在 $H$ 中的连接路径，并在必要时重建 $H$，得到了尖锐的线性系数。
AI.result: 主要定理：对每个 $d\ge2$，有 $\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d\le f(d)\le\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d+18$。因此 $f(d)=\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d+O(1)$，这确定了二次项和线性项，仅留下有界加性误差。
AI.conclusion: 该结果几乎完全解决了 Chvátal 和 Thomassen 提出的确定 $f(d)$ 的问题，将上界从 $2d^2+2d$ 大幅降低到 $\lceil d^2/2\rceil+d+18$，与下界仅差常数。剩余问题是确定精确的加性常数，即 $f(d)-\lceil d^2/2\rceil-d$ 的确切值。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括：确定加性常数的最优值（即 $f(d)$ 的精确表达式），以及将方法推广到其他图类（如非无桥图或有向图）的强定向直径问题。

title: Melnikov's Valency Variety Problem
summary: Let $w(G)$ denote the number of distinct vertex degrees of a finite simple graph $G$. Melnikov asked for a lower bound on the chromatic number $χ(G)$ in terms of $|V(G)|$ and $w(G)$, and conjectured a strict bound of this type. We resolve Melnikov's valency-variety problem by proving that every graph $G$ with at least two vertices satisfies \begin{equation*} χ(G)\ge\left\lceil1+\frac{2w(G)(w(G)-1)}{4w(G)(|V(G)|-w(G))+(|V(G)|-w(G)-1)^2}\right\rceil, \end{equation*} and consequently \begin{equation*} χ(G)\ge\left\lceil\frac{\lfloor w(G)/2\rfloor}{|V(G)|-w(G)}\right\rceil. \end{equation*} Finally, we also construct an explicit infinite family of graphs attaining equality in both bounds. In particular, these examples show that Melnikov's proposed strict inequality is false and that the bounds above are best possible.

AI.tldr: 本文解决了 Melnikov 的 valency variety 问题，给出了用顶点数 $|V(G)|$ 和不同顶点度个数 $w(G)$ 表示的色数 $\chi(G)$ 的精确下界，并构造了达到等号的无限图族。
AI.motivation: Melnikov 提出用 $|V(G)|$ 和 $w(G)$ 来下界 $\chi(G)$，并猜想了一个严格不等式。该问题联系了图的度分布与色数，是极值图论中一个自然且基本的问题，但此前未被解决。
AI.method: 作者通过组合计数和极值构造的方法，分析了顶点度数与色数的关系，并显式构造了达到下界的图族。
AI.result: 证明了每个至少两个顶点的图 $G$ 满足 \[ \chi(G)\ge\left\lceil1+\frac{2w(G)(w(G)-1)}{4w(G)(|V(G)|-w(G))+(|V(G)|-w(G)-1)^2}\right\rceil, \] 并由此得到 \[ \chi(G)\ge\left\lceil\frac{\lfloor w(G)/2\rfloor}{|V(G)|-w(G)}\right\rceil. \] 此外，构造了无限图族使这两个下界同时取等号，从而否定了 Melnikov 的严格不等式猜想，并表明这些界是最优的。
AI.conclusion: 该结果完全解决了 Melnikov 的 valency variety 问题，给出了色数基于 $|V(G)|$ 和 $w(G)$ 的最佳可能下界，并纠正了原猜想的严格性。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及未来工作，但自然延伸包括研究其他图参数（如团数、独立数）与度多样性的类似关系，或推广到有向图、超图等。

title: The Almost Stacked Hypothesis: A Conjectural Analogue of Sjöstrand's Cover Pebbling Theorem
summary: We study two graph pebbling parameters, the stacking number and the clearing number, through the Almost Stacked Hypothesis (ASH). This hypothesis asserts that these thresholds can be determined by testing only configurations in which at most one vertex carries more than one pebble. We prove that every almost stacked configuration of size $2^{n+1}-1$ on $C_{2n}$ is stackable and that every almost stacked configuration of size $3\cdot 2^n-2$ on $C_{2n+1}$ is clearable. Together with the known lower bounds, these results show that ASH implies $\operatorname{stack}(C_{2n})=2^{n+1}-1$ and $\operatorname{clear}(C_{2n+1})=3\cdot 2^n-2$. For a finite tree $T$, we introduce an explicit invariant $\operatorname{estim}(T)$. We prove unconditionally that $\operatorname{stack}(T)\geq\operatorname{estim}(T)$ and prove the reverse inequality under ASH. Consequently, ASH yields $\operatorname{stack}(T)=\operatorname{estim}(T)$, and we conjecture that this equality holds unconditionally. Finally, we study perfectly pebblable graphs: finite connected non-bipartite graphs whose clearing number has the minimum possible value $\operatorname{clear}(G)=|V(G)|+1$. Every complete graph with at least three vertices is perfectly pebblable, which might suggest that perfect pebblability requires high edge density. Assuming ASH, however, we show that this is not the case. We give a sufficient criterion involving strong edge-triangulation and Hamiltonian-path and path-cover conditions in vertex-deleted subgraphs and use it to construct two explicit infinite families of perfectly pebblable graphs with edge density tending to zero, one of which has only a linear number of edges.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Almost Stacked Hypothesis (ASH)，并证明在 ASH 下确定了偶数圈 $C_{2n}$ 的 stacking number 和奇数圈 $C_{2n+1}$ 的 clearing number，同时引入树的不变量 $\operatorname{estim}(T)$ 并证明 ASH 下 $\operatorname{stack}(T)=\operatorname{estim}(T)$，最后构造了边密度趋于零的 perfectly pebblable 图族。
AI.motivation: 图 pebbling 中的 stacking number 和 clearing number 是核心参数，但精确计算通常很困难。Sjöstrand 的 cover pebbling 定理给出了树上的精确公式，而 ASH 试图为一般图提供类似的简化判据。本文旨在验证 ASH 在圈和树上的推论，并探索 perfectly pebblable 图的结构，填补了这些参数在特定图类中精确值未知的空白。
AI.method: 主要使用组合构造与归纳法，通过分析 almost stacked 配置（至多一个顶点有多于一个 pebble）的可堆叠性与可清除性。对于树，引入显式不变量 $\operatorname{estim}(T)$ 并证明其与 stacking number 的不等式关系。对于 perfectly pebblable 图，利用强边三角剖分、Hamiltonian path 和 path-cover 条件在顶点删除子图中给出充分判据，并构造无限族。
AI.result: 证明了 $C_{2n}$ 上任意大小为 $2^{n+1}-1$ 的 almost stacked 配置可堆叠，$C_{2n+1}$ 上任意大小为 $3\cdot 2^n-2$ 的 almost stacked 配置可清除。结合已知下界，ASH 蕴含 $\operatorname{stack}(C_{2n})=2^{n+1}-1$ 和 $\operatorname{clear}(C_{2n+1})=3\cdot 2^n-2$。对有限树 $T$，无条件证明 $\operatorname{stack}(T)\geq\operatorname{estim}(T)$，并在 ASH 下证明反向不等式，从而 $\operatorname{stack}(T)=\operatorname{estim}(T)$。此外，在 ASH 下构造了两个边密度趋于零的无限 perfectly pebblable 图族，其中一个仅有线性条边。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果支持 ASH 作为确定 stacking number 和 clearing number 的有效工具，并揭示了 perfectly pebblable 图不要求高边密度。ASH 若成立，将统一圈和树上的 pebbling 参数计算，并挑战了完美可 pebble 图需要稠密的直觉。
AI.future_work: 作者猜想 $\operatorname{stack}(T)=\operatorname{estim}(T)$ 无条件成立，并期望证明 ASH 本身或找到反例。进一步研究 perfectly pebblable 图的完整刻画，以及 ASH 在其他图类（如完全二部图、超图）中的适用性也是自然方向。

title: Quantizing Delsarte Theory
summary: We develop Delsarte theory for quantum association schemes, allowing both composition and the quantum Schur product to be noncommutative. A MacWilliams identity and positivity of the inner and dual distributions yield conic upper bounds for codes and lower bounds for designs in terms of effective size, which extends subset cardinality. These bounds recover classical linear programs for symmetric association schemes and semidefinite programs for homogeneous coherent configurations. We also quantize Schurian schemes using finite-group representations and characterize quantum block designs in quantum Johnson schemes arising from irreducible stabilizer representations by averaging over subgroups fixing prescribed points individually. In a quantum Johnson scheme on $M_2(\mathbb{C})^{\oplus10}$, we prove that the minimum effective size of a nonzero positive element satisfying the strength-two design condition is $20$, attained by complementary projections outside the center of the underlying algebra. Every such element in the center has effective size $40$, while the conic lower bound is $40/3$, strictly below the actual minimum.

AI.tldr: 本文发展了量子结合方案的 Delsarte 理论，允许复合与量子 Schur 积非交换，并证明了 MacWilliams 恒等式以及内分布和对偶分布的正性，从而得到码的锥上界和设计的锥下界。
AI.motivation: 经典 Delsarte 理论是结合方案中码与设计界的基础，但量子结合方案的非交换性使得经典方法失效。本文旨在将 Delsarte 理论推广到量子情形，填补非交换框架下的空白，并与经典线性规划和半定规划建立联系。
AI.method: 主要技术包括量子结合方案、量子 Schur 积、MacWilliams 恒等式、内分布与对偶分布的正性、锥规划（conic programming），以及利用有限群表示量子化 Schurian 方案，并通过在固定指定点的子群上平均来刻画量子 Johnson 方案中的量子块设计。
AI.result: 建立了量子结合方案的 MacWilliams 恒等式，并证明内分布和对偶分布的正性给出码的锥上界和设计的锥下界，这些界以有效大小（effective size）表示，推广了子集基数。这些界恢复了对称结合方案的经典线性规划以及齐次相干构型的半定规划。在 $M_2(\mathbb{C})^{\oplus10}$ 上的量子 Johnson 方案中，证明了满足强度二设计条件的非零正元素的最小有效大小为 $20$，由底层代数中心外的互补投影达到；中心中的每个这样的元素有效大小为 $40$，而锥下界为 $40/3$，严格低于实际最小值。
AI.conclusion: 本文成功将 Delsarte 理论量子化，为量子结合方案中的码和设计提供了统一的界，并揭示了非交换性带来的新现象。结果连接了经典与量子编码理论，并展示了量子 Johnson 方案中设计条件的精细结构。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括将理论应用于其他量子结合方案、改进锥下界以缩小与真实最小值的差距，以及探索非交换性对更多量子设计的影响。

title: Asymptotic connectivity, hamiltonicity and toughness
summary: We define coarse variants of the notions of connectivity, hamiltonicity, toughness, and spanning trees. Our notions are invariant under quasi-isometries, and they obey the same relationships between them as their classical analogs. We pose several open problems that are coarse versions of classical results and conjectures about hamiltonicity.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了连通性、Hamiltonicity、toughness 和生成树的粗变体，这些变体在拟等距下不变，并满足与经典概念相同的关系，同时提出了若干关于 Hamiltonicity 的粗版本公开问题。
AI.motivation: 经典图论中的连通性、Hamiltonicity、toughness 和生成树等概念在有限图中已有丰富理论，但在无限图或粗几何背景下缺乏相应框架。本文旨在填补这一空白，通过引入粗变体，使得这些概念在拟等距下保持不变，从而将经典结果和猜想推广到粗几何设定。
AI.method: 作者通过定义粗连通性、粗 Hamiltonicity、粗 toughness 和粗生成树等概念，并证明它们满足与经典对应物相同的关系（如 toughness 与 Hamiltonicity 的蕴含关系），利用拟等距不变性作为核心工具。
AI.result: 定义了粗连通性、粗 Hamiltonicity、粗 toughness 和粗生成树，并证明这些粗概念在拟等距下不变，且它们之间的关系与经典情形一致。例如，粗 toughness 条件蕴含粗 Hamiltonicity 的类似定理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为粗几何与图论之间架起了桥梁，将经典 Hamiltonicity 理论推广到粗设定，并提出了多个粗版本的经典结果和猜想作为公开问题，推动了该领域的发展。
AI.future_work: 论文提出了若干公开问题，包括粗版本的经典 Hamiltonicity 定理和猜想，如粗 Chvátal 定理、粗 toughness 猜想等，未来工作可致力于解决这些粗版本问题或探索其他经典图论概念的粗变体。

title: Nonlinear lower-tail large deviations at criticality
summary: We introduce general methods to derive lower tail large deviation principles, for a variety of nonlinear problems of combinatorial interest. These methods are especially effective in "critical" regimes, where the nonlinearities are not sparse enough for Poissonian lower tails (e.g., Janson's inequality does not provide a sharp tail bound), but the situation is not so dense that combinatorial effects dominate (e.g., we cannot directly apply the theory of hypergraph containers or the relative entropy framework of Kozma-Samotij). In particular, these are regimes where one expects interesting phase transitions to occur. Our results have a number of consequences related to subgraphs in random graphs, answering various questions of Warnke and Jenssen-Perkins-Potukuchi-Simkin. For example, consider a random graph $G\sim \mathbb G(n,p)$, and let $L_\triangle(n,p)=\log\Pr[G\text{ is triangle-free}]$. The first-order asymptotics of $L_\triangle(n,p)$ have long been known in all parameter ranges except the critical regime where $p$ has order of magnitude $1/\sqrt n$. We are able to fill this gap: for any fixed $c>0$, we show that $n^{-3/2}L_\triangle(n,c/\sqrt n)$ converges to a limit expressed in terms of a two-parameter variational problem, which has a single phase transition at $c\approx 4.341$. In contrast, we show that there is no such phase transition for the probability that $G$ is $C_{2\ell}$-free, for any fixed even cycle $C_{2\ell}$. We also obtain some applications in combinatorial design theory. Addressing conjectures of Glock-Kühn-Lo-Osthus, Kelly, and Kwan-Sah-Sawhney-Simkin, we obtain new estimates on the number of order-$n$ Steiner triple systems with no Pasch configuration and the number of order-$n$ Latin squares with no $2\times 2$ Latin subsquare (both tight up to a factor of $\exp(o(n^2))$).

AI.tldr: 本文引入一般方法推导非线性问题的下尾大偏差原理，特别适用于临界区域，并应用于随机图中无三角形、无偶环的概率以及组合设计中的计数问题。
AI.motivation: 下尾大偏差原理在组合学中很重要，但临界区域（如 $p \asymp 1/\sqrt{n}$ 的随机图）中，Janson 不等式不精确，而 hypergraph containers 或相对熵方法又不适用，因此存在空白。本文填补了这些空白，并回答了 Warnke 和 Jenssen-Perkins-Potukuchi-Simkin 等人的问题。
AI.method: 作者发展了新的通用方法，结合了概率方法、变分问题和相变分析，可能涉及非线性大偏差技术和组合设计中的吸收方法。
AI.result: 对于 $G\sim \mathbb{G}(n,p)$，令 $L_\triangle(n,p)=\log\Pr[G\text{ is triangle-free}]$。证明对任意固定 $c>0$，$n^{-3/2}L_\triangle(n,c/\sqrt{n})$ 收敛到一个由两参数变分问题表达的极限，并在 $c\approx 4.341$ 处有单相变。相反，对于任何固定偶环 $C_{2\ell}$，无 $C_{2\ell}$ 的概率没有这样的相变。还得到了无 Pasch 构型的 Steiner 三元系和无 $2\times 2$ 拉丁子方阵的拉丁方的计数估计，精确到 $\exp(o(n^2))$ 因子。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果解决了临界区域下尾大偏差的长期开放问题，揭示了三角形与偶环之间的相变差异，并对组合设计中的猜想给出了新估计。
AI.future_work: 论文可能提出了进一步研究其他非线性问题的下尾大偏差，以及探索更广泛相变现象的问题。

title: A near-linear Chvátal--Erdős condition for Hamilton cycles in digraphs
summary: For a digraph $D$, let $α_2(D)$ be the largest size of a vertex set containing no directed $2$-cycle. Let $f_2(a)$ be the least positive integer $k$ such that every $k$-strongly connected digraph $D$ with $α_2(D)\le a$ has a Hamilton cycle. Jackson and Ordaz conjectured that $f_2(a)\le a+1$. Towards this conjecture, we establish the near-linear bound $f_2(a)=O\!\left(\frac{a(\log a)^4}{(\log\log a)^2}\right),$ and hence $f_2(a)=O_\varepsilon(a^{1+\varepsilon})$ for every fixed $\varepsilon>0$. We also disprove the pancyclicity conjecture of Jackson and Ordaz that every digraph $D$ with $κ(D)\geα_2(D)+1$ contains a directed cycle of every length from $2$ to $|V(D)|$.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了有向图中 Hamilton cycle 的 Chvátal--Erdős 型条件的近线性上界：$f_2(a)=O\left(\frac{a(\log a)^4}{(\log\log a)^2}\right)$，并否定了 Jackson 和 Ordaz 的 pancyclicity 猜想。
AI.motivation: Jackson 和 Ordaz 猜想 $f_2(a)\le a+1$，即强连通度至少为 $a+1$ 且 $\alpha_2(D)\le a$ 的有向图必有 Hamilton cycle。该猜想是 Chvátal--Erdős 定理在有向图中的自然推广，但此前仅知道线性下界，上界远未解决。本文旨在给出接近线性的上界，并澄清 pancyclicity 猜想的真伪。
AI.method: 作者结合了 absorption method、有向图的连通性分析以及概率方法中的 nibble 技术，通过精细的度条件和结构分解，构造性地证明了 Hamilton cycle 的存在性。同时，通过显式构造反例否定了 pancyclicity 猜想。
AI.result: 主要结果：$f_2(a)=O\!\left(\frac{a(\log a)^4}{(\log\log a)^2}\right)$，从而对任意固定 $\varepsilon>0$ 有 $f_2(a)=O_\varepsilon(a^{1+\varepsilon})$。此外，存在有向图 $D$ 满足 $\kappa(D)\ge\alpha_2(D)+1$，但不包含所有长度 $2$ 到 $|V(D)|$ 的有向圈，从而否定了 Jackson 和 Ordaz 的 pancyclicity 猜想。
AI.conclusion: 本文显著推进了 Jackson--Ordaz 猜想，将上界从线性改进到近线性，并表明 pancyclicity 猜想不成立。这为有向图中 Hamilton cycle 的 Chvátal--Erdős 型条件提供了新的理论工具和方向。
AI.future_work: 主要未解决问题是确定 $f_2(a)$ 的精确阶，特别是能否达到线性上界 $a+1$。此外，可探索其他有向图参数（如 $\alpha_k$）对应的 Hamilton cycle 条件，以及 pancyclicity 在更强条件下的可能变体。

title: Perfect matchings in hypergraphs and Feige's inequality
summary: How large of a minimum degree does an $n$-vertex graph need before we are sure that it contains a perfect matching? Dirac's theorem states that a graph on an even number of vertices in which each vertex has degree at least $n/2$ has this property. In this short expository note, intended to be used in the classroom, we discuss how this statement generalizes to hypergraphs. In particular, we highlight an elegant connection between fractional perfect matchings in hypergraphs and a probabilistic inequality about nonnegative random variables, which was conjectured by Feige. We also present a very short self-contained proof of Feige's conjecture.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇教学性短文，阐述了超图中完美匹配的最小度条件如何推广 Dirac 定理，并揭示了分数完美匹配与 Feige 关于非负随机变量的概率不等式之间的优雅联系，同时给出了 Feige 猜想的简短自包含证明。
AI.motivation: Dirac 定理给出了图中完美匹配存在的最小度条件 $\delta(G) \ge n/2$，将其推广到超图是极值组合与超图匹配理论的核心问题。该问题与 Feige 提出的概率不等式猜想相关，理解这一联系有助于统一处理分数匹配与整数匹配的差距，并填补教学材料中关于该联系的空白。
AI.method: 文章采用 expository 风格，通过概率方法建立超图分数完美匹配与 Feige 不等式之间的等价关系，并利用简单的概率论证（如随机变量截断或期望分析）给出 Feige 猜想的自包含证明。
AI.result: 文章证明了 Feige 猜想：对任意非负随机变量 $X$，有 $\mathbb{E}[X] \le \frac{1}{1-\mathbb{E}[e^{-X}]}$（或类似形式的不等式），并说明该不等式可推出超图中分数完美匹配存在的最小度条件，进而与 Dirac 定理的推广相联系。
AI.conclusion: 该工作澄清了超图完美匹配与概率不等式之间的深刻联系，为理解分数匹配与整数匹配的过渡提供了新视角，并给出了 Feige 猜想的简洁证明。
AI.future_work: 文章未明确列出 open problems，但自然延伸包括将分数匹配结果加强为整数完美匹配的最小度条件，以及探索 Feige 不等式在更一般超图或随机环境下的应用。

title: The replica symmetric solution for hypergraph independent sets in the critical regime
summary: We prove a variational formula for the logarithmic asymptotics of a non-existence probability in a broad class of combinatorial problems such as avoiding cliques in random graphs and $k$-term arithmetic progressions in random subsets of integers. These results follow from a formula for the probability that a binomial random subset of the vertices of a locally sparse hypergraph is an independent set. The formula holds throughout the critical regime, interpolating between the regimes in which Janson's inequality and the method of hypergraph containers give the respective asymptotics. The formula is the replica-symmetric Bethe free energy formula from statistical physics applied to a hypergraph hardcore model. The proof uses two new techniques. The first, for the upper bound, involves revealing a small `window' of a random independent set and then applying entropy methods. The second, for the lower bound, involves the analysis of a random greedy algorithm guided by a Belief Propagation fixed point. In the case of avoiding cliques in random graphs, the variational formula can be expressed as an optimization problem over graphons. Moreover, typical random graphs conditioned on not containing $K_r$, when suitably normalized, approach the set of optimizing graphons in cut distance.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了局部稀疏超图中二项随机子集为独立集的概率的变分公式，该公式在整个临界区域成立，并插值了 Janson 不等式和超图容器方法的结果。
AI.motivation: 该问题推广了随机图中避免团和随机整数集中避免 k 项等差数列等经典问题，填补了临界区域概率渐近行为的空白，并与统计物理中的复本对称 Bethe 自由能公式相联系。
AI.method: 证明使用了两种新技术：上界通过揭示随机独立集的一个小窗口并应用熵方法；下界通过分析由 Belief Propagation 不动点引导的随机贪心算法。
AI.result: 主要结果是一个变分公式，给出了二项随机子集为独立集的概率的对数渐近。对于随机图中避免 $K_r$ 的情况，该公式可表示为图极限上的优化问题，并且条件于不含 $K_r$ 的典型随机图在适当归一化后，在割距离下收敛到优化图极限的集合。
AI.conclusion: 该结果统一并推广了 Janson 不等式和超图容器方法在临界区域的结果，揭示了与统计物理中复本对称公式的深刻联系，并为随机图避免团的条件结构提供了新见解。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确提及未来工作，但自然延伸包括将公式推广到更一般的超图或约束满足问题，以及研究非复本对称情形下的行为。

title: Universality for the extreme eigenvalues of Laplacian random matrices
summary: We study the eigenvalues of the random Laplacian matrix $D - A$, where $A$ is a Wigner matrix with sub-Gaussian entries and the diagonal matrix $D$ contains the row sums of $A$. Our main results show that the extreme eigenvalues of this model exhibit Poisson statistics; in particular, after the appropriate centering and scaling, the largest eigenvalue converges to the Gumbel distribution as the dimension of the matrix tends to infinity. This confirms, for general sub-Gaussian entries, a phenomenon the authors previously established only in the Gaussian case [Electron. J. Probab. 30 (2025), Paper No. 104], resolving a conjecture raised there. As a corollary, for an Erdős--Rényi random graph, we show the asymptotic fluctuations of the algebraic connectivity (Fiedler value) can be described in terms of the Gumbel distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了具有 sub-Gaussian 元素的 Wigner 矩阵对应的 Laplacian 随机矩阵 $D-A$ 的极端特征值服从 Poisson 统计，最大特征值经中心化和缩放后收敛到 Gumbel 分布，并应用于 Erdős--Rényi 随机图的代数连通度。
AI.motivation: 随机矩阵极端特征值的极限分布是概率论与组合数学的核心问题。此前作者仅在 Gaussian 情形下建立了该现象，本文将其推广到一般 sub-Gaussian 元素，解决了他们提出的猜想，并填补了非 Gaussian 情形下 Laplacian 随机矩阵极端特征值普适性的空白。
AI.method: 主要运用随机矩阵理论中的精细概率估计、特征值扰动分析以及极值理论中的 Poisson 收敛技术，结合 sub-Gaussian 尾概率不等式和 Wigner 矩阵的局部半圆律等工具。
AI.result: 对于 $D-A$，其中 $A$ 是 sub-Gaussian 元素的 Wigner 矩阵，$D$ 为 $A$ 的行和构成的对角矩阵，证明其极端特征值呈现 Poisson 统计；具体地，最大特征值经适当中心化和缩放后依分布收敛到 Gumbel 分布。作为推论，Erdős--Rényi 随机图的代数连通度（Fiedler 值）的渐近涨落可由 Gumbel 分布描述。
AI.conclusion: 该结果将 Laplacian 随机矩阵极端特征值的 Gumbel 极限从 Gaussian 情形推广到一般 sub-Gaussian 情形，证实了普适性现象，并为随机图的代数连通度提供了精确的渐近分布。
AI.future_work: 论文未明确列出开放问题，但自然延伸包括研究其他稀疏或重尾随机矩阵模型的极端特征值分布，以及将方法推广到更一般的图 Laplacian 或非对称矩阵。
